Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

message — a short piece of communication. Example: I send a message to my friend.
email — a message you send by computer. Example: I send an email to my teacher.
phone — a telephone. Example: My mother calls me on the phone.
text — a short written message on a mobile. Example: I write a text message.
send — to make something go to a person. Example: Can you send the file?
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I send an email.
• I write a text message.
• I call on the phone.
• Send it to me, please.
• I answer my messages.
